summary: Aarogya Aggregator MVP — backend + frontend (Expo web) tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (health, seed, auth incl. register/login/me, geohash-scoped nearby search, type/student filters, geohash isolation Mumbai/Delhi NOT returned for Bengaluru, facility detail with inspector_ratings & avg_user_rating, review create+list, stock-request full flow with role enforcement, admin/all + 403 for patient, admin/inspect toggles verified, clinic_owner can PUT own facility). Frontend: login screen renders with 6 language chips + demo credentials hint and submit works; patient home shows results sheet with 7 facility cards within 2km / pharmacy filter narrows to 3; type/radius chip taps re-fetch; facility detail shows verified badge, student discount banner, inspector ratings bars, user reviews, and Stock Check CTA (primary-action-button) opens stock-modal — POST /api/stock-requests confirmed 200 in backend logs; profile tab shows user info, 6 language chips, medical info card and Log out; clinic@aarogya.in routes to /clinic/dashboard listing 'Apollo MediCare Clinic' + Verified + Student friendly + stock requests section; admin@aarogya.in routes to /admin/dashboard with stats (6 pending / 5 verified / 11 total) and tapping a pending row opens inspection-modal with 15 rating cells + grant-verified-button; language switch on login verified (Log in → लॉग इन). bcrypt warning in backend (passlib + bcrypt 4.x version detection) is cosmetic only — hashing/verification works.

minor.issue: backend/.env DB_NAME='test_database' is generic; consider renaming to 'aarogya_db' for clarity, but does not affect tests.
passlib + bcrypt 4.x prints '(trapped) error reading bcrypt version' on startup. Functionality OK. Pin bcrypt<4 or use passlib>=1.7.5 patch / switch to bcrypt-only to silence.

issues: 'shadow*' style props deprecated warning from RN-web — use boxShadow for cleaner console (cosmetic).
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — SafeAreaView/header pointerEvents='box-none' should be moved into style prop (cosmetic).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated 'shadow*' style props in StyleSheet (Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts shadow.* and login.tsx/home.tsx via ...shadow.card/floating). React Native >=0.76 expects 'boxShadow' on web. Cosmetic now, will break in future RN-web.
Uses pointerEvents='box-none' as JSX prop instead of style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:101

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Pin bcrypt<4 in backend/requirements.txt or upgrade passlib to remove the '(trapped) error reading bcrypt version' startup warning.
(Optional cosmetic) Replace 'shadow*' RN-web style props with 'boxShadow' in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence deprecation warnings.
(Optional cosmetic) Move pointerEvents='box-none' into style prop on SafeAreaView in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:101.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py respects MONGO_URL/DB_NAME env vars, excludes _id everywhere, uses async motor calls, proper Pydantic validation, role-guarded routes (require_role), and idempotent seed via delete_many — clean.
Geohash prefix prefilter + haversine post-filter correctly isolates Bengaluru from Mumbai/Delhi facilities (verified by test_geohash_isolation_mumbai_not_returned).
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via apiFetch — no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements have testID — excellent automated-testing coverage.
All text wrapped in <Text>; no raw strings detected.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested critical flows (login, home filters, facility detail, stock check submit, profile/language, clinic dashboard, admin dashboard incl. inspection modal)

seed_data_creation: Used existing POST /api/seed/reset (4 users, 11 facilities incl. Bengaluru/Mumbai/Delhi, 5 inspections marking 5 facilities verified, ~10 reviews). Test data prefixed with TEST_ where added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend stable. JWT auth uses bearer header. Seed is idempotent. Stock-modal 'Sent' indicator resets after 1.2s — when testing, either inspect backend log for POST /api/stock-requests 200 or sample DOM within ~1s. Admin dashboard pending rows use testID 'pending-<id>' and verified rows 'verified-row-<id>'; inspection modal is 'inspection-modal' with rating cells like 'cleanliness-5', 'price-transparency-4', 'equipment-5'.
rca_of_issue: No blocking issues found. Cosmetic warnings only.
